android.desc:
PetPal is a pet-care app for pet owners, Pals (caregivers), and veterinary clinics. Keep each pet’s profile, health history, and reminders in one place, then book walks, clinic visits, and appointments when you need help.

FOR PET OWNERS
* Add pet profiles with photos and basic details
* Log vaccinations, medications, weight, allergies, conditions, and visit notes
* Set reminders and alarms for vaccines, doses, and daily care
* Share a care summary when someone else looks after your pet
* Find available Pals and request a walk, vaccination visit, or checkup
* Discover clinics, book appointments, and view prescriptions
* Chat with your Pal after a booking is confirmed

FOR PALS
* Browse pets that owners have listed for walks and clinic visits
* Send or accept booking requests, then chat with the owner
* Complete identity verification so you can appear as an available Pal

FOR CLINICS
* Register your practice, specialists, and published services
* Manage appointment requests from pet owners
* Write and send prescriptions linked to a visit

TRUST AND PRIVACY
Pals and clinics are reviewed before they appear in the app. PetPal uses account sign-in to protect your data. Read our Privacy Policy in the app for details on how information is collected and used.

Download PetPal to keep records current, never miss a reminder, and connect with Pals and clinics when your pet needs care.
